name: gp-fill-sources
prompt: In server/src/gameplan.rs replace the body of `pub fn fill_sources` (currently `todo!()`). For every task in `plan.asset_tasks` that has no `library_id` and no `workflow`: find the output its kind needs with `output_of_kind(&task.kind)` (skip the task when None); choose the workflow: first the one in `workflows` whose `name` equals the task's kind lower-cased and whose `output` equals that output, otherwise the first workflow in `workflows` whose `output` equals it; skip the task when there is none. Set `task.workflow = Some(name)`; when that workflow has a parameter named "prompt" insert `"prompt"` = the task's `title` as a JSON string into `task.params` (use `Value::String(task.title.clone())`). Push the task's key onto the result and return the keys in plan order. Do NOT add tests or modules: the tests are in gameplan_tests.rs. Change nothing else.

name: gp-call-fill
prompt: In server/src/gameplan.rs, function `generate`: directly after the line `prefer_library(&mut plan, library);` add the line `fill_sources(&mut plan, workflows);`. Do NOT add tests or modules. Change nothing else.
